aliases: C Spire Advanced Data Solutions Starkville
status_detail: C Spire announced in October 2013 that it would build a Tier III-class commercial data center at the Thad Cochran Research, Technology and Economic Development Park in Starkville, with 22,400 square feet on a 6.5-acre site and first customer use expected in November 2014. C Spire later announced the facility's official opening on December 4, 2014 as a $23 million, 23,800-square-foot commercial data center offering colocation, managed hosting, computing, storage, disaster recovery and network connectivity.
notes: Commercial data center, not a hyperscale AI campus. No MW found in public C Spire materials reviewed.

project_name: AVAIO Digital Taurus Data Center Hub
aliases: East Metropolitan Center data center campus
status_detail: Rankin First says AVAIO is the developer, owner and operator of a new data center campus currently under development in Brandon, with an initial $6 billion Phase 1 investment at East Metropolitan Industrial Center. AVAIO's project page says Taurus in Brandon, Rankin County is a 329-acre turnkey/powered-shell campus, broke ground September 10, 2025, has 1,036 MW total baseload power, 536 MW grid power and 500 MW behind-the-meter baseload, and targets first occupancy in August 2027.
notes: MDA/governor and Rankin First announce $6B project; AVAIO developer page provides most detailed power/site values. Cleanview lists Taurus as 116 MW planned, but AVAIO's own site reports the broader 1,036 MW power envelope.
